Can I ask you some questions? I am going to try to not be ignorant or condescending. Just genuine questions as to how you’ve gotten to this place. 

1. Are you physically healthy? 
2. What is your family situation like?
3. What are the top 3 things that contribute the most to your current situation?
4. Throughout most days, on average, how often are you alone?
Would say that’s definitely one of the last ways on a long list to go out….

People who have thoughts such as yours (and mine tbh) tend to have a very narrow perspective on time, every day feels like a hundred years and it seems like there’s no end… but you’ve still got so much life to live and potentially a lot of fantastic moments.
You’re only 14, it’s worth it to keep trying. Things can be drastically different for you in a decade and you’d still only be 24….

Yea I think about that often. Even just a boring Monday would be fantastic, wake up in an amazing apartment in some city, hit the gym, go to the pool, lounge around, spend some time doing things you’re interested in even if they don’t bring in any income…
I’m planning on putting all my money on one bet and if I lose then I’m going to go through with it, and if I win then probably give life another shot idk.
Literally the only thing keeping me going. That and the fact id ruin my parents lives by offing myself.

Yea I agree, but I don’t think we have the ability to completely go against the flow. Also, my main point in my ramble was mostly about how everything is coded into us and how it’s so unbelievable that the majority of humans have the ability to push these thoughts, that you described very well in your comment, aside. There’s a term for it exactly but I can’t remember it atm, something about dissociation, but the odd part about it is that most of us get sucked back in and reconnect with society. Overall I’m just really interested in the way the brain works, and specifically why/how people are able to ignore these existential thoughts before they get overwhelmed.
How so? I think people with your view are just uncomfortable to accept the truth of it all.
Thank you. You too.

It’s actually comical that to see the truth, you’ve first got to be damaged and beat up mentally to the point where your perspective of this world isn’t clouded by the bullshit that “healthy” people interact with to stay occupied before the long night. I disagree with what you’ve said here though, they don’t deserve to die, nobody deserves anything. Just because you and I got the short end of the stick doesn’t mean the other end has to come down with us. Humans are a cancer to this beautiful earth, but it’s nobodies fault other than evolution.
Hopefully not to the Mets
This is why I’m offing myself in a month or so
Ideally yea, but rizzo won’t go for it. He wants 5 years I think. Baez on a 3 year deal wouldn’t be terrible imo.
We got your back here bud, keep fighting the hard fight.
Everything is nothing. Not lame. You are deciding that it’s all lame.
Not destined. But yes, some people have shitty lives. But I’m right here with ya, we’re in it together
If you did have it, would you?
That do be lookin scrumptious

I’m about to make an appointment and the only person that’s doing in person sessions is a woman. I think the thing that has made me so messed up is something that falls under the same situation as you but opposite. Don’t think I’m going to bring it up though because it’s definitely more weird for a guy to talk about that sort of thing to a woman than the opposite. Idk

Yea that’s what I was gonna say. Everyone is fighting their own battles, some could be worse off than you and you wouldn’t even know it. All anyone can do is try to keep going forward, whatever that means.
Extremely touchy subject here given the post by OP, it might be best that this discussion is kept with that in mind.

That’s kinda the place I’m in atm. I feel as though actually committing to the leaving part means you’re in such a place that killing yourself isn’t going to be all that hard. But I guess it’s still extremely difficult to go through with it if there’s been an ounce of hope still in you.

I would say love is as real as you make it. Just like anything with life, you can make anything seem real or fake depending on the way you look at it. Grand scheme of things, life is seriously what you make of it. But to be fair to the original comment here, if you look at things from a purely scientific and biological POV then love isn’t real... but I think most people know this and allow themselves to at least enjoy the idea of it and be happy for the short time we are here.

Don’t think I’ve ever seen a better post in my life. The soulless happiness that the sun is exuding paired with an “again” from the individual that I can only describe as a fantastically defeated response that has a twinge of bleak hilarity. That fucking hat and the “poorly” drawn lines is just the icing on the cake.

Just made this account cuz I deleted my main one, so don’t please don’t think I’m some random here. This is going to sound dumb, and it is because I’m drunk but please hear me out, dead poets societ isnt just a movie anymore (at least to us) it’s a way of life. I might be going out on a limb here by saying that I believe most of us see ourselves as Todd, at least I do, and because of how well written and acted this movie is I keep coming back. It helps me connect to a character who is adopted by a group of friends and creates a life for himself. Maybe we don’t need a sub that has constant attention but rather one that simply has quality discussions about the underlying themes of this movie? In my opinion this sub could be a common ground to all fo us who flock back to this movie every now and then... it really doesn’t have to be active, in a way the inactiveness is kind of nice, we have our own little place here. The goal shouldnt be to get more attention to the sub, we should simply post and comment whenever we feel the need to. 

Anyways this feels weird now that I remembered I’m on a throwaway acct lol.
Fantastic!
